description: Java class 'SawVoice' that implements a synthesizer voice with a sawtooth oscillator and an ADSR envelope, extending the 'SynthVoice' base class.

classes.name: SawVoice
classes.description: Represents a sawtooth oscillator with ADSR envelope for MIDI synthesis, extending 'SynthVoice'.

methods.name: SawVoice
methods.description: Constructor that initializes oscillator and envelope instances.

methods.name: createOscillator
methods.description: Creates and returns a new 'SawOscillator' instance.

methods.name: noteOn
methods.description: Handles starting a note, setting pitch and amplitude, and triggering the envelope.

methods.name: noteOff
methods.description: Handles stopping a note and releasing the envelope.

methods.name: setFrequencyScaler
methods.description: Sets a frequency scaling factor on the oscillator.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Generates the current audio sample by combining oscillator and envelope outputs.

methods.name: isDone
methods.description: Checks if the envelope has finished its release phase.
